question: Can I cast a spell for its sneak cost during the declare blockers step on my turn?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: spells can be cast for their sneak costs any time you could play an instant during the declare blockers step on your turn, after your opponent has decided whether to block.
expected.answer: Spells can only be cast for their sneak costs any time you could play an instant during the declare blockers step on your turn (after your opponent has decided whether to block).
